from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r,c)]
            seen.add((r,c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop()
                comp.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append(comp)
    motif_comp = max(comps, key=len)
    coords = sorted(motif_comp)
    if len(coords) > 1 and len({r for r,c in coords}) == 1:
        coords = sorted(coords, key=lambda p:p[1])
        offsets = [(0,c-coords[len(coords)//2][1],grid[r][c]) for r,c in coords]
    else:
        coords = sorted(coords, key=lambda p:p[0])
        offsets = [(r-coords[len(coords)//2][0],0,grid[r][c]) for r,c in coords]
    motif_set=set(motif_comp)
    seeds=[comp[0] for comp in comps if len(comp)==1 and comp[0] not in motif_set]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in seeds:
        for dr,dc,color in offsets:
            y,x=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                out[y][x]=color
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-44eef5cb.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
